title: Blake Ruwali | Entrepreneur, founder of Techeo and Home+ Air & Heat, owner of Takeo.AI
meta_desc: Blake Ruwali is a New York entrepreneur, the founder of Techeo, Home+ Air & Heat, Com+ Mechanical and Long Island HVAC Repair, and the owner of Takeo.AI.
og_desc: New York entrepreneur. Founder of Techeo, Home+ Air & Heat, Com+ Mechanical and Long Island HVAC Repair. Owner of Takeo.AI.
hero_h1: From a Himalayan village without heat to building AI for the people who install it.
hero_lede: I'm Blake Ruwali. I run Home+ Air & Heat in New York, and through Techeo I build the AI behind it.
portrait_caption: Blake Ruwali, founder of Techeo and Home+ Air & Heat
stat3: counties served: Nassau, Suffolk and all of NYC
build_h2: AI in every step, from the first scan to the warranty.
build_p: Home+ is where every Techeo system is built and tested first, on real homes and real customers. After the design, an AI phone agent answers when the office can't, and customers sign proposals and memberships on their phone.
shot1_alt: 3D model of a home built from an iPad LiDAR scan, rooms colored by comfort
shot1_text: A tech walks the house with an iPad. LiDAR builds a 3D model of every room, colored by how comfortable it runs.
shot2_alt: Top-down floor plan projected from the scan, with room areas
shot2_text: The same scan becomes a floor plan with real room sizes, so nobody sizes a system off a guess.
shot3_alt: Chart of the home's heating and cooling load across outdoor temperatures
shot3_text: A Manual J load calculation shows exactly how hard that house pulls in winter and summer. AI picks the system that fits.
story_quote: "In Nepal, winters without heat meant getting sick every year. In the US that stopped, and I never forgot why."
story_body: In 2025 the system in my new house kept breaking down. I got to know the technician who kept coming back, and started Home+ to rebuild HVAC the way I build software: measure everything, design for the person, and put AI in every step.
story_fact_html: Blake Ruwali is an American entrepreneur based in New York. Blake founded Techeo and Home+ Air & Heat, and owns Takeo.AI, which Blake led as President and CEO from 2019 to 2025. Blake holds a Master of Science in Information Technology from the University of the Cumberlands and a Bachelor of Business Administration in Global Information Systems from Troy University.

takeo_p: I led Takeo.AI as President and CEO from 2019 to 2025, running technology bootcamps, career services and consulting. I still own it.
techeo_quote: "Agencies tell half-truths, then push the work back onto the company."
techeo_body: Techeo runs the same systems we run at Home+ (AI search, marketing, call answering and follow-up) for one HVAC or plumbing company per market, with a 90-day performance guarantee.
